name: Sonos
author: tskyrm
description: Sonos now-playing in the Omarchy bar, with a popup to control every room: transport, group and per-speaker volume, grouping, favorites and a SiriusXM channel picker.

barWidget.description: Bar pill with what the main Sonos room is playing and a popup controlling every room.

schema.label: Bar room
schema.description: Room the bar follows (e.g. Living Room). Empty follows whichever room is playing.

schema.label: Python with soco
schema.description: Optional. A python that can import soco. Empty sets up a private venv in ~/.local/share/omarchy-sonos on first run.
